title: Is Your Menu Board Readable From the Door?

scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.say: Sorry, what does the board say?

props.label: THE MENU
props.line: Can they read it *from the door*?

scenes.say: If guests can't read the board, they don't browse. They order the one thing they know, or they walk out.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: Everything fits if you write small
props.fact: If they can't read it, they order the safe thing

scenes.say: Sign makers use a simple rule. About an inch of letter height for every ten feet. So if your door is twenty feet away, write two inches tall.
So: stand at the door and read your own board. Cut it to fewer items. And put the best sellers biggest.

props.title: Fix the board
steps: Read it from the door yourself
